column3: “God Almighty” renders “El Shaddai,” and “a company of peoples” renders “an assembly (qahal) of peoples.”
“a ladder” renders a word used only here, which may mean a stairway or ramp.
“above it” may also be read “beside him.”
“then the LORD will be my God” may also be read as part of the condition, with the apodosis in verse 22.
